movement_profile.footwork: Intricate, rapid movements, V-shapes, heel-toe transitions
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes jumping in the Xhop variant

signature_moves.description: Tracing the letters C-R-I-P with the feet
signature_moves.name: V-move

signature_moves.description: Alternating heel and toe contact with the floor
signature_moves.name: Heeltoe

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Slow for Crip/Crown, fast for Clown

music_profile.sound_description: Characterized by G-funk's heavy, melodic basslines and repetitive synth hooks that provide a steady pulse for intricate footwork.

basic_steps: V-move: shifting weight to trace a V-shape with the feet
Heeltoe: alternating heel and toe contact with the floor
Xhop: a jumping movement used in Crown Walk
teaching.level_notes: Beginner: focus on the V-move; Intermediate: focus on beat-matching; Advanced: incorporate Clown/Crown variations.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time, typically slow for Crip/Crown and fast for Clown
